actions.action: Enclose plant in clear plastic bag, container or mini greenhouse for humidity
Open the enclosure briefly for air
Move plant to a warm spot (18–25°C) away from cold glass, vents and drafts
Check soil moisture by lifting pot and finger test 2–3 cm
Water only when top of soil is slightly dry
Make sure pot drains and empty any standing water
Optionally trim the fully brown leaf tip
Watch for warning signs (mushy/black stem, sour smell, spreading dark patches)
If rot signs appear, check the roots

reason: The answer explicitly downplays cold damage and treats it only as a possible contributor to transit shock. It includes the humidity enclosure but tells the owner to keep the damaged leaves and keep watering, the opposite of the chop-and-don't-water fix, which would likely delay recovery.
